operation.summary: What's on the owner's screen right now (no prompt once they've turned it on)

query.name: size
query.description: Preset: agent (1568 px, q85), thumb (512, q75), large (2560, q90), original

query.name: max_edge_px
query.description: Long edge limit, 64-20000; overrides the preset

query.name: raw
query.description: 1 = return the image bytes, details in X-Bridgit-* headers

body.name: mode
body.description: private (default): taken in memory, never put in the gallery

body.name: store
body.description: Keep this capture too: any of memory (fetch it later from GET /v1/captures/{id}), files (a copy in the phone's Downloads/Bridgit), upload (POSTed to your upload_url). [] or "none" = only return it. Default: your POST /v1/captures/storage choice, else only returned

operation.returns: captured_at, width_px, height_px, format, size_bytes, mode, data_base64 (or raw=1 bytes); capture {capture_id, stored, url, memory_until, file} when kept (X-Bridgit-Capture-Id with raw=1)

mode.description: private (default): taken in memory, never put in the gallery

max_edge_px.description: Long edge limit, 64-20000; overrides the preset

size.description: Preset: agent (1568 px, q85), thumb (512, q75), large (2560, q90), original

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice
